5 تشكّل It (a thing, TA) was, or became, formed, fashioned, figured, shaped, sculptured, or pictured; syn. تَصَوَّرَ. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- And He became goodly in shape, form, or aspect. (TK in art. طرز.) ―
-b3- تشكّل العِنَبُ, (S, K,) and ↓ شَكَلَ , and ↓ شكّل , (K,) The grapes became in that state in which some of them were ripe: (S, K:) or became black, and beginning to be ripe: (K:) thus in the M. (TA.) ―
-b4- See also 4, near the end. ―
-b5- And see 1, also near the end.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
